**Which direction failed**

- [ ] Mac to iPhone or iPad
- [ ] iPhone or iPad to Mac
- [ ] Watch to iPhone
- [ ] A capture from Siri, a Shortcut or a widget never appeared anywhere

**When** (date, time, your time zone), and roughly when you last reinstalled
or updated Ledge on the device that is missing the notes.

**Recovery report from the Mac**

Right-click the Ledge menu bar glyph, choose Recovery, press "Copy diagnostic
report", and paste it below. It contains counts, timestamps, digests and
device names, and never the text of your notes; the app has a test that
keeps it that way.

```
paste here
```

**What the other device shows**

On the iPhone: the health line under the capture bar, if any, and whether
`inbox.md` in Files > iCloud Drive > Ledge shows a download icon.

**Do not paste your notes.**
